ValidationRule.description: Company and Registered Company are Mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT($Permission.CCRM_Skip_Validation), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.AdobeIntegrationUserName)), AND( TEXT(Entity_Type__c) != 'Individual', TEXT(Entity_Type__c) != 'Customer Lending Group' ), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', OR( ISBLANK(Company), ISPICKVAL(Registered_Company__c, '') ), NOT( AND( Text(Status) = 'Outcome', Text(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'Expired' ) ), NOT(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c), OR( Skip_Validations__c = 'SkipValidation', Skip_Validations__c = 'Validate' ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Registered Company and Company name are required to proceed.
